resources.string: The Vulkan driver the game runs on. The device\'s own driver is the tested one. Changes apply the next time you press Play; if the game won\'t start or looks wrong, go back to the device\'s own driver.

PanVK is an open-source Mali driver from Mesa, by zenithblue-oss/panvk-kbase-android. It decodes BC textures on the GPU instead of the CPU. It is experimental: games can freeze, and some phones with this GPU generation rebooted with it. Back up before trying it. The app downloads it (about 9 MB) from the project\'s GitHub release and checks its checksum.
Experimental driver selected. If the game closes, freezes or the device restarts, switch back to the device\'s own driver.
Options for the device\'s own Mali driver, from MaliBridge\'s measurements. They apply the next time you press Play.
The game runs at most one frame ahead of the GPU (DXVK maxFrameLatency 1). Controls respond a frame sooner when the GPU is the limit, for about 1% fps.
Mali can\'t read the game\'s BC textures, so they are converted to ASTC. This uses 8×8 blocks instead of 4×4: less memory and faster loading, but blurrier textures.

The official app\'s CurseForge connection doesn\'t serve this Mali build. With your own CurseForge API key, searching, installing and updating CurseForge addons works here too. The key is stored encrypted on this device and is only sent to CurseForge.
